featured_reviews.review_text:
Clean, affordable, but can get crowded

The BMC pool in Malad is neat and well-maintained, making it a great option for regular swimmers.

The subsidized fees are a big plus, especially for students and senior citizens. Even for adult fees is hardly 8k.

The only downside is that it gets too crowded during some batch timings, so try to go during off-peak hours for a better experience.

featured_reviews.review_text: BMC swimming pool 25 mtrs x 15 mtrs and have hourly batch timing starting from 0600 for 45 mins session each.

featured_reviews.review_text: The filtration unit at BMC Malad swimming poor is not functioning since past few days, the water has become dirty and the color has changed to green. Members have to swim in this dirty water or go home as the staff has not taken any action to solve this issue. Members are getting skin allergy and irritation after swimming in this dirty water.

featured_reviews.name: Siddharth Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:

The staff at reception is friendly, helpful & courteous. The coaches are good and knowledgeable.

The coaches are excellent and supportive, especially for beginners. They focus on proper techniques and make learning easy and enjoyable. The training experience feels structured and professional.

Overall, it’s a great place for both learning swimming and regular practice, with good facilities, good coaching, and a positive atmosphere.

featured_reviews.name: Almas Palana
featured_reviews.review_text: There is absolutely no alignment between the office staff and the coaches. The coach keeps changing, mine changed thrice in 3 days. The one who took trial said I needed to be enrolled in “basic swimming” but the coach who came in later said I was supposed to be put in the semi - development batch (which is exactly what I told the trial coach and the office reception staff but nobody gave a damn). The coach wouldn’t even enter the pool on a lot of days and only sit outside the pool. There is no order set for regular members and students. People swim crossing each other and that’s so weird. They won’t let you use the dive circuit if they’re not in a good mood. Just a horrible place to consider for learning. If you’re rich enough, take a membership and nobody would say a word. If you’ve enrolled to learn, they will act like they are the superior to you lol. Very stupid set of coaches and the staff. Join micheal Philip instead. Such a good staff, so much better pool, temperature controlled, and great vibes. That’s what I will enroll for once this wasted deal ends.

featured_reviews.name: Avinash Tauro
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very small pool but ok for a kids. However it is not maintained well and has a couple of cracked tiles, when I visited last. Also the showers in the changing rooms are not clean. The water accumulates quickly and you are left standing in angle deep dirty water by the time you are done with the shower. Also the place is always deserted. That is not only unsafe for kids but also gets you wondering why no one goes here.
I did not know this when we had taken a 1 month family package last year for 20k and next day itself my daughter suffered a fracture, we informed the club to keep it on hold and emailed them as requested. Then school started and doctor also advised longer rest. We emailed and called the club again in Jun. Again we were assured of no problem and we can join back when we can. We never received any reply to our emails but were told face to face everything is ok.
When we went to continue our membership this year, we were told that they can keep the membership on hold only for 3 months. However neither we were given receipt for our payment nor told the rule in our conversations or reply to emails.
So now I know why no one goes there. They are expensive with terrible customer support. My wife and me was planning to join the annual gym membership this year but I can't trust them anymore.
Also speaking to our company's legal team, they recommended to not take it forward and it could cost as much or more than 20k for legal fees. This is what the gym banks on when taking as much money as possible from customers without giving anything in return.
So stay away is my recommendation.

featured_reviews.name: Лилия
featured_reviews.review_text:
After receiving multiple advertisements for swimming classes at Michael Phelps, I enrolled my child in a trial class, eager to see if it would be a good fit for our family. However, after the trial class, I was informed that the school is fully booked and cannot accommodate my child in the regular sessions.

This experience has been frustrating and very misleading. It is disappointing to realize that despite the time and effort spent attending the trial class, there was no possibility of enrolling my child in your program due to the lack of available spots. This crucial information was not communicated to us beforehand, this should be clearly stated prior to booking trial classes.

Advertising trial classes when there are no available spots for regular enrollment is fraudulent and unprofessional. It creates false hopes and wastes valuable time for both parents and children.

I urge you to review this and ensure that clear and transparent communication is provided in the future. Prospective clients should be informed of the availability of spots before enrolling in any trial classes to avoid such disappointments.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We regret the inconvenience you faced. Nevertheless it may be that the spot of your choice wasn't available at the time of your trial. We will try our best to improve the experience for our clients.Many thanks for your feedback.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The MPS coaching in Andheri West Raheja centre is an excellent place to learn and develop swimming skills. The coaches are very good and the pool is also very well maintained. Happy to have my son enrolled in this academy.MPS is highly recommended for the reasons below
1) The coaches very well understand how to handle the kids and encourage them
2) My kid has overcome the fear of swimming in just a few sessions
3) Individual attention as coach and student ratio of 1:6 is followed
4) The progress of every child is monitored on a regular basis. So the parents also get to know how much a child has learnt.

featured_reviews.name: Ryan Rodricks
featured_reviews.review_text:
Been here numerous times for swim meets and various events.

The 50M pool is very well maintained, clean and proper demarcation of lanes. Has a full 7 lanes with the 1st and 7th being extra wide.

Has a 5M diving board for diving facilities.

Clean and well kept wash amd changing rooms are provided.

Gets very crowded on weekends and holidays. Especially in the summer.

Coaching facilities are provided and has numerous staff on hand for any swimming and coaching requirements.

The canteen is a bit lacking in food and taste but does provide tea/coffee and light snacks.

The seating arrangements need improvement which is where I deducted 1 star. The seats are hard narrow and cramped and very little space to move or walk around.

Overall one of the best and well maintained pools in the suburbs and maintenance and cleanliness standards are very high.

featured_reviews.review_text: Top-notch facilities! The ozone water treatment makes a massive difference—super clean and great for sensitive skin. Friendly atmosphere and highly recommended!"

featured_reviews.review_text: Management for Ozone Swimming Pool Systems involves systematically collecting, analyzing, and acting on customer input. This helps improve satisfaction, address common issues like maintenance challenges or performance expectations, refine installations/services

featured_reviews.name: Rajiv
featured_reviews.review_text:
Really a very nice pool managed by BMC.
It is a 50 metre olympics size pool which conducts training and hosts various interschool, district and state level events.

Apart from this they maintain a small pool for kids as well.

The Name is OZONE because they maintain Ozonized water in the pool.

The yearly training fee is very much affordable for a normal family as well. They just charge RS. 6800/- as regular fell and almost 1000/- extra for learners. Rs 18/- they charge as daily locker fee and one may opt for a yearly fee of RS 700.

45 mins slot and government staff approach is another prospect where you may feel little disappointed 😞☹️
Parking is also a concern here.

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Tondwalkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ozone has two swimming pool. One for the kids and one for proper swimming.
The swimming pool is ozonized and it is well maintained.  There are many life guards for the safety of its members. The pool has maximum depth of 18 feet.

The pools water is really nice and it is one of the cleanest pools in the locality. As a swimmer one can get yearly membership at 6764/- and for learners it is extra 1000/-.

One member has to select one of the batches available and then has to come only during that particular batch only.  There is no particular parking space for two / four wheeler so one has to park on the road at their own risk.

Locker facility is available at 18/- per day basis or a yearly fee if 720/-.

featured_reviews.name: Shankar Chauhan
featured_reviews.review_text: Have joined the last summer camp with my daughter in Ozone swimming pool, near vivek college, Goregaon west. Have taken morning batch from 9 am to 10 am. The pool is open from morning 9 am to evening 7 pm. Open for all ages. The trainers are good here. The pool has different sizes, it start from 3 feet to 18 feet. Now a days me and my daughter is using floaters for swimming 🏊‍♀️. The morning time is little busy. Can take yearly membership for Rs 7000.

customer_updates.name: Suraj subba Apologia
customer_updates.text:
We had a wonderful community picnic at Saina Resort on the 8th of June. I always enjoy the food, swimming, and the many activities available there. This year, the addition of the wave pool and football turf made the experience even more enjoyable and unique.

The staff were friendly and communicated well throughout our visit. The food was good, and the complimentary pani puri and dosa were a nice touch. The resort also has plenty of space, making it ideal for large groups and community gatherings.

I would give it 4 out of 5 stars. The only area that needs improvement is cleanliness and maintenance in some parts of the property. Overall, it was a great experience, and we had a memorable day together.

Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5)

featured_reviews.name: PRAMILA KUDUMULA
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited this resort for the second time because they had recently started a wave pool, and we were very excited to enjoy it. A few days earlier, my brother had visited and shared a very good review about the wave pool experience, which made us even more excited to visit.
However, after entering the resort and completing the payment, nobody informed us that the wave pool would not be accessible. Later, we found out that the wave pool had been given for a shooting and was occupied throughout the entire day.
We were extremely disappointed because the main reason for our visit was the wave pool. At the very least, the management should have informed guests in advance or reduced some amount from the charges since we could not use one of the main attractions. Unfortunately, there was not even an apology from the staff regarding the inconvenience caused.
Our second experience at the resort was very disappointing compared to the first visit.
Other than this issue, the food was very good and enjoyable.

featured_reviews.name: Snehal Pranav Pradhan
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited Saina Resort for the very first time. I stayed with my Mother, daughter and niece.
Food and staff service is excellent.
Property is located in a secluded place so commute is an issue unless you have your own vehicle.
The rooms were spacious and clean but being an old property some maintenance might be required.
Room amenities are good comes with an Android Smart TV.
Huge property but too many steps everywhere. Not recommended for senior citizens or people with knee or mobility issues.
Good engagement for kids- Swimming pool, water park and play area.
Overall a pleasant stay.
Thanks Team Saina Resort for your hospitality 😀

featured_reviews.name: Milind Ghadi
featured_reviews.review_text: Good location.  Good for family picnic.  Good co-operative Manager Mr. Umesh and his supporting staff.  Cleaniness was good.  Chlorine in swimming pool water was in control.  Complaint attendance was faster.   Veg Non-Veg food was tasty.  In short, it is worth to visit again.

featured_reviews.review_text:
On behalf of Yashwantrao B. Chavan English Medium High School, I would like to express our sincere appreciation to Saina Resort for the excellent arrangements made during our school picnic.
The overall experience was truly wonderful. The food quality was awesome, hygienic, and enjoyed by both students and staff. The resort staff was very good, polite, and cooperative, ensuring safety, comfort, and smooth coordination throughout our visit.
Special mention to Umesh Sir, who was extremely cooperative and guided us very well at every stage. His support, guidance, and prompt assistance made the entire picnic well-organized and stress-free.
We are highly satisfied with the hospitality and management of Saina Resort and would definitely recommend it for school picnics and group visits.

– Supervisor
Yashwantrao B. Chavan English Medium High School

Water in the pool is clean, thus they have kept it maintained. The Life Saver sitting near the Big Pool is very Helpful and attentive to help whenever needed, thts y I gave 5 star for Service.
From 11:30am to 1:30pm they do serve live counter near the Rides Pool.

featured_reviews.name: Deep Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
POORLY MAINTAINED BADMINTON COURT (hardly any room on sides)

Court Leakage : Multiple Leakages on the court during monsoon leading to players slipping and injuring themselves. This has been the condition for a long time.

Ventilation : Pathetic. Exhaust and inlet vents are completely BLOCKED. Have to play suffocated and in extreme humidity. Only inlet for oxygen is when you open the main entrance door. This too has to be kept closed as it affects the shuttle play.

Location : Filthy. Area is remote and NO PARKING.

Toilets : Missing. There are no toilets for this court.

Drinking Water : Tank empty.

Upon complaints with the management, their response shows a extremely casual approach.

They are least bothered above upgrading the facilities and appears Money Minded.

featured_reviews.name: Mitesh Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: My 6-year-old child and I joined swimming sessions as complete beginners, with no prior experience. The coaches are amazing—calm, patient, and dedicated to teaching each swimming form step by step. In just 6-7 months, I successfully learned all four strokes. A special mention to Jeevan Sir, whose exceptional teaching techniques make swimming easier for non-swimmers. He is an outstanding instructor who continuously motivates you to push beyond your limits. The sessions have helped me to increase my stamina and flexibility. Rahul sir and Omkar sir are also great instructors. Kudos to the team. Keep up the good work.

featured_reviews.name: shweta salve
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sportiqo has been amazing for my swimming journey!
Vivek Sir's calm and patient teaching style helped me overcome my fear of water and build confidence. He's an incredible coach, and I'm so grateful for his support. 5 stars isn't enough - he's truly one of the best!

featured_reviews.name: Rishika Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have joined swimming class for my 7 year old, who has learnt it beautifully under the supervision of Jeevan Sir and Omkar Sir. Their playful attitude while handling kids is commendable making it a easy friendly learning experience for the little learners.
Jeevan Sir's dedication and encouragement and structured approach have made  his learning process very enjoyable and effective.
Appreciate the positive environment he creates for the learners.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Prasad Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text: I had joined the swimming training programme over here with my 6 year old son. Children usually learn fast but the problem was to teach an adult like me. I had severe hydrophobia initially, however expert coaches like Vivek Sir, Rahul Sir, Aniket Sir and Jeevan Sir made it appear so smooth a process and navigated me so easily throughout by increasing my stamina and encouraging me at every single step. They ensure to teach you technically correct methods and no shortcuts are taught. They push you through smoothly and make you believe on your own capacity, that yes , you make it possible finally. Thanks a lot Sportico academy.

featured_reviews.name: raunak varma
featured_reviews.review_text:
This sport becomes more of fun when u have fab coaches like Jeevan, Rahul, Vivek and Aniket. Still remember my first 10 sessions, where I struggled with freestyle and there came Rahul.. who build my endurance, Jeevan who took all my tantrums patiently and pushed me everyday to be a better version of myself at the pool. Vivek to correct my form and lastly Aniket who dived in whenever his expertise was needed..
love u guys..
A special thanks to Jeevan and Rahul.

featured_reviews.name: Primary Coordinator
featured_reviews.review_text:
My 4 and half year old son has progressed in swimming amazingly well under the supervision of Jeevan sir 👌 He has a wonderful way of connecting and making himself understood to even such young kids. Seeing the joy on my son’s face every time we say it’s time for swimming lessons- is a testament to how amazing the coaching at DSC SPORTIQO is.
Big big kudos to Jeevan sir 🙏🏻 and the other coaches Roshan sir and Om sir as well !

featured_reviews.name: HAPPY LUCKY
featured_reviews.review_text: "Jeevan Sir is an extraordinary swimming coach who transforms swimmers with his expertise, patience, and unwavering dedication. His ability to break down complex techniques into simple, effective lessons makes learning effortless and enjoyable. He not only refines strokes and builds endurance but also instills confidence and discipline in his students. His passion for coaching and keen attention to individual progress set him apart. If you're looking for a coach who inspires, motivates, and brings out the best in you, Jeevan Sir is truly unparalleled!"
